title: Timestamp to Date Conversion and Daily Grouping
description: Group user events by **date** (stripping the time component from timestamps) and **event type**. Show each date, event type, and the event count. Convert timestamps to dates using DATE_TRUNC or CAST.
solution_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', event_timestamp)::DATE AS event_date, event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', event_timestamp)::DATE, event_type ORDER BY event_date, event_type

test_cases.description: Jan 5: page_view=2, click=1, purchase=1. Jan 6: page_view=2, click=2. Jan 7: page_view=1, click=1, purchase=2. Total 8 (date, event_type) combinations.

hints: Use DATE_TRUNC('day', event_timestamp) to strip the time portion and keep only the date part — cast to DATE for a clean DATE type output.
Group by both the truncated date and event_type to get counts per day per event type.
explanation: DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) sets the time component to midnight (00:00:00), effectively converting a timestamp to its date. Casting to DATE removes the time suffix from the display. Grouping by date and event_type produces 8 combinations. Jan 5 has 4 events across 3 types. Jan 6 has 4 events across 2 types (no purchases). Jan 7 has 4 events across 3 types including 2 purchases.
